metadata.description: Agent Skills for vibe engineering — 33 plugins and 140 evidence-grounded practitioner skills spanning security, compliance, cloud infrastructure, identity automation, DevSecOps, AI/ML, data engineering, frontend, mobile, desktop, smart TV, game development, UI/UX design, systems programming (assembly, OS and kernel, languages, browsers, package managers), embedded and IoT, blockchain, quantum computing, penetration testing, software architecture, quality engineering, engineering process, and technical writing.

plugins.name: agile-delivery
plugins.description: Agile Delivery: Security-First Scrum methodology, evidence-based delivery velocity, and engineering metrics.

plugins.name: ai-and-data
plugins.description: AI and Data Engineering: data pipelines and warehousing, AI/ML landscape and production patterns, RAG and AI agent development, and LLM token and cost optimization on Azure (including provider-agnostic prompt/context compression).

plugins.name: ai-chatbot-strategy
plugins.description: AI Chatbot Strategy: foundational AI and chatbot concepts for business, RAG architecture explained for non-technical decision-makers, custom chatbot build and deployment guide, and chatbot business value with ROI frameworks.

plugins.name: assembly-programming
plugins.description: Assembly Programming: instruction-level reference for x86-64, AArch64, and RISC-V — the machine model, calling conventions and ABIs, assemblers and toolchains, reading disassembly, performance engineering, SIMD/vector (SSE/AVX/AVX-512, NEON/SVE2/SME, RVV), systems and constant-time cryptographic assembly, inline assembly and intrinsics, and debugging/verification.

plugins.name: azure-cloud-infra
plugins.description: Azure Cloud Infrastructure: Azure RBAC administration, Kubernetes IaC with GitOps/Helm/Terraform, and Azure service catalog with production decision guide for compute, messaging, networking, and AI.

plugins.name: compliance-frameworks
plugins.description: Compliance Frameworks: NIST 800-171, PCI-DSS v4, SOC 2, CMMC/CUI, and OWASP SAMM security compliance guidance.

plugins.name: cryptocurrency-development
plugins.description: Cryptocurrency Development: blockchain engineering at both layers — protocol (consensus and finality, execution/consensus clients, the EIP process, EVM internals, L2s and rollups, cross-chain) and application (Solidity/Vyper, contract architecture and upgradeability, ERC standards and account abstraction, DeFi primitives and MEV, Foundry/Hardhat testing, fuzzing and formal verification, the vulnerability canon, deployment and key management).

plugins.name: desktop-apps-macos-linux
plugins.description: Desktop Apps (macOS & Linux): platform architecture (Darwin/launchd/bundles vs kernel/compositor/D-Bus/systemd), SwiftUI/AppKit and GTK4/libadwaita/Qt6, cross-platform frameworks (Electron, Tauri, Flutter, Avalonia, Compose Multiplatform, Rust GUIs), Wayland vs X11, native desktop idioms, packaging and distribution (notarization, Mac App Store, Flatpak, Snap, AppImage, distro packages), auto-update, sandboxing and privacy (TCC, entitlements, XDG portals), and testing/CI.

plugins.name: devsecops-cicd
plugins.description: DevSecOps and CI/CD: end-to-end pipeline security, Bitbucket/Azure DevOps integration, CI/CD field guide with OIDC/supply-chain/progressive delivery, and GitHub/Atlassian advanced practitioner survey.

plugins.name: ecommerce-development
plugins.description: eCommerce Development: commerce and payments systems — architecture, the payment lifecycle (authorization, capture, settlement, refunds), integration engineering (idempotency, webhooks, reconciliation, state machines), PSPs and gateways (Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree), payment methods and rails (cards, wallets, ACH/SEPA, SWIFT/ISO 20022, BNPL, instant payments), SCA and 3-D Secure, authorization rates and decline handling, fraud and chargebacks, PCI DSS scope and the SAQ A trap, subscriptions and billing, marketplaces and payouts, tax and cross-border, the platform layer (Shopify, headless, custom), catalog/cart/checkout and conversion, and agentic commerce protocols.

plugins.name: embedded-iot-controls
plugins.description: Embedded Systems & IoT Controls: silicon, memory, and peripherals; bare-metal, RTOS, and embedded Linux firmware models; C/C++/Rust; real-time concurrency and timing; firmware design patterns; industrial control and OT (PLC, fieldbus, OPC UA, unified namespace); control theory in firmware; connectivity (BLE, Thread, Matter, LoRaWAN, cellular, MQTT/CoAP/Sparkplug); cloud, fleet, and OTA lifecycle; device security and regulation (CRA, RED/EN 18031, IEC 62443, PSA); functional safety (IEC 61508, ISO 26262, DO-178C, IEC 62304); testing; and board bring-up.

plugins.name: engineering-process
plugins.description: Engineering Process: requirements gathering and elicitation, SDLC models and practices, process engineering and project management frameworks, and research methodology with Turabian citation standards.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Frontend Design: graphic design and UX/UI best practices, Next.js production patterns, and full-stack performance optimization for Python, Next.js, and Azure.

plugins.name: machine-learning
plugins.description: Machine Learning: problem framing and when not to use ML, data work and leakage, the classical toolkit (gradient boosting, linear models, clustering), deep learning fundamentals and architectures (transformers, CNNs, diffusion), the PyTorch/JAX ecosystem and torch.compile, training at scale (DDP, FSDP, tensor/pipeline parallelism, mixed precision), fine-tuning and PEFT/LoRA, honest evaluation, debugging training, inference and serving (vLLM, SGLang, quantization, KV cache), MLOps and reproducibility, hardware and cost, and interpretability, fairness, and safety.

plugins.name: mobile-development
plugins.description: Mobile Development: enterprise mobile on Azure — React Native New Architecture, native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) and Android (Kotlin/Compose), mobile UI/UX and design patterns, Azure hosting/Intune/CI-CD after App Center, and mobile security (OWASP MASVS, secure storage/comms, MFA/passkeys).

plugins.name: network-engineering
plugins.description: Network Engineering: networking fundamentals from first principles through 2026 gold standards including eBPF, Cilium, and AKS.

plugins.name: okta-api-reference
plugins.description: Okta API Reference: the core Management REST API and official Python SDK, the Identity Governance (OIG) API surface and its lack of a Python SDK, and the current landscape of MCP servers for Okta core and IGA automation.

plugins.name: okta-workflows
plugins.description: Okta Workflows: a field reference for identity source-of-truth → Okta sync pipelines (e.g. Entra ID) — the platform's production quirks, hard record caps, and verified workarounds across branching (If/Else & If/ElseIf), looping constructs, Tables, event hooks/streaming/handler flows, the Okta and Azure AD/Microsoft Entra ID connectors, execution limits & throttling, error handling & retry, and flopack import/export, plus the recent 2025–2026 platform changes.

plugins.name: os-development-kernel-shell
plugins.description: OS Development (Linux Kernel & Shell): kernel architecture and programming in C and Rust, modules and drivers, kernel concurrency, syscalls and the userspace ABI, eBPF and sched_ext, boot and init, systemd/cgroups/containers, the kernel development process, debugging and tracing (ftrace, perf, KASAN, crash dumps), security and hardening, plus the shell layer — POSIX sh/bash/zsh/fish/nushell semantics and their traps, choosing a shell, defensive scripting, and the coreutils/systemd userland.

plugins.name: package-manager-development
plugins.description: Package Manager Development: version schemes and constraints, manifests, dependency resolution (backtracking, SAT, PubGrub, MVS), lockfiles and reproducibility, registry design, cache/layout/linking (flat, nested, content-addressed, PnP), publishing and authentication (trusted publishing, OIDC, provenance, Sigstore, SLSA), supply-chain attacks and defenses, lifecycle scripts, workspaces and monorepos, performance, UX, the cross-ecosystem comparison (npm, pip/uv, Cargo, Go modules, Maven, NuGet, apt/dnf, Nix), and governance.

plugins.name: penetration-testing
plugins.description: Penetration Testing and Offensive Security: authorized offensive work as a profession — the authorization and legal foundation (CFAA, Computer Misuse Act, bug bounty and VDP scope, rules of engagement) that separates it from a crime, engagement types and scoping, the standard methodologies (PTES, OWASP WSTG, NIST SP 800-115, MITRE ATT&CK), reconnaissance and attack surface, testing per domain (web, network, Active Directory and identity, cloud, API/mobile/wireless/OT/hardware), social engineering and physical, red/purple teaming and post-exploitation, testing AI systems, and reporting, remediation, coordinated disclosure, and career and certification. A methodology, process, and professional-practice reference — not an exploit cookbook.

plugins.name: programming-language-development
plugins.description: Programming Language Development: language design decisions and their consequences, lexing and parsing, names/scopes/modules, type systems (inference, HM, bidirectional, subtyping, generics, traits, effects, ownership, dependent types), intermediate representations (SSA, CPS, ANF, MLIR-style), optimization, code generation and backends (LLVM, Cranelift, custom, WebAssembly), runtime systems and GC, interpreters and JITs, diagnostics, incremental compilation and IDE support, testing and verification, standard library and ecosystem design, and language evolution and governance.

plugins.name: quality-engineering
plugins.description: Quality Engineering: Python testing and quality practices, test strategy and frameworks, and systematic debugging with observability — structured logging, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, and error handling patterns.

plugins.name: quantum-computing
plugins.description: Quantum Computing: the physical and mathematical foundations and the circuit model, what quantum computers can and cannot do, the algorithm canon (Shor, Grover, HHL, VQE/QAOA, quantum simulation) and their honest complexity claims, noise and the NISQ era, error correction and fault tolerance, hardware modalities and where the hardware actually is, the software stack (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, CUDA-Q, OpenQASM), resource estimation, evaluating quantum-advantage claims, applications, quantum networking and sensing, and post-quantum cryptography and migration deadlines.

plugins.name: security-first-dev
plugins.description: Security-First Development: secure greenfield development with Security-First Scrum, codebase modernization, and enterprise cybersecurity implementation.

plugins.name: security-principles
plugins.description: Security Principles: cybersecurity first principles, threat modeling playbook, AI-era security field guide, and AI safety and secure development practices for Python and TypeScript/Next.js.

plugins.name: smart-tv-app-development
plugins.description: Smart TV App Development: the platform landscape (Roku, Tizen, webOS, Android TV/Google TV, Fire OS, Vega OS, tvOS, VIDAA, SmartCast) and programming model per platform, the 10-foot UI and focus/spatial navigation, remote-control input, video playback and adaptive streaming (HLS/DASH), DRM (Widevine, PlayReady, FairPlay), performance and memory on constrained hardware, lifecycle and deep linking, monetization and CTV advertising (VAST, SSAI, ad pods), certification and store submission, testing on real devices, analytics/QoE, cross-platform strategy, and accessibility, privacy, and ACR.

plugins.name: software-architecture
plugins.description: Software Architecture: production architecture for Python, Next.js/TypeScript, and Azure at scale; Azure architecture patterns; and the software design process including ADRs, C4 model, fitness functions, and just-enough design.

plugins.name: ui-ux-design-principles
plugins.description: UI/UX Design Principles: the perceptual and cognitive science underneath interface decisions, usability heuristics and mental models, information architecture and navigation, input and interaction per form factor, layout and responsive/adaptive design, visual design (typography, color, space, motion, iconography), design systems and tokens, platform conventions (Apple HIG, Material 3, GNOME/KDE HIG, Fluent), accessibility law and practice (WCAG 2.2/3.0, EAA, ADA Title II, APCA), UX writing, forms/onboarding/conversion, research and evaluation, ethics and dark-pattern regulation, and AI-era interface patterns.

plugins.name: vibey-bootstrap
plugins.description: vibey-bootstrap (formerly azure-bootstrap): usage reference for the vibey-bootstrap Python library (v4.0.0) — the 4-phase logging↔config bootstrap, v2 stdlib primitives, ten logging transports, opt-in Tier 2/Tier 3 subpackages, v3 DB/outbox/email/HTTP/AKS/governance/scaffold modules, end-to-end recipes, and TypeScript/Next.js HTTP integration plus pattern ports.

plugins.name: video-game-development
plugins.description: Video Game Development: engine selection and licensing, the game loop and time step, code architecture (ECS vs OOP), rendering pipelines and graphics APIs, physics and collision, animation, audio, gameplay AI and pathfinding, networking and multiplayer (rollback, prediction, lag compensation), tools and content pipelines, performance and frame budgets, game feel, build/test/QA and certification, production and scope management, and the business context (live ops, monetization, platforms, legal).

plugins.name: web-browser-development
plugins.description: Web Browser Development: the engine landscape, the multi-process model with IPC and sandboxing, networking (HTTP/2/3, TLS, caching, DNS), HTML parsing and the DOM, CSS cascade and style resolution, layout/paint/compositing and the GPU pipeline, JavaScript engine integration and the event loop, the security model (same-origin policy, CORS, CSP, site isolation, Spectre mitigations, memory safety), privacy and anti-tracking, extensions, storage/media/capabilities, accessibility, standards and interop, and testing, telemetry, and shipping.

plugins.name: writing-craft
plugins.description: Writing Craft: white paper writing, prose mechanics, technical prose, narrative structure, and elite legal brief writing.
